headline: Ultra Clean Holdings Surges 11% on Q3 Earnings Beat and Strong Outlook
summary: Ultra Clean Holdings shares surged 11% following third-quarter financial results that beat estimates alongside an upbeat forward guidance.
why: Ultra Clean Holdings is a critical subsystems and manufacturing solutions supplier to the semiconductor capital equipment industry.

impacts.name: Ultra Clean Holdings, Inc.
impacts.why: Shares rallied 11% following better-than-expected third-quarter earnings and an optimistic sales forecast.

why_moved: Ultra Clean shares jumped 11% after the semiconductor equipment supplier exceeded third-quarter profit expectations and issued strong forward guidance.
